name: Activity Digest Rollup
description: Single consolidated email every 3 hours summarizing everything that happened across the agent fleet — shipped recs, queued recs, deferred recs, failed runs, eBay catalog growth, articles published, H2H pairs proposed, and any escalations. Replaces the per-agent confirmation/proposal/completion emails (which are now suppressed via DIGEST_ONLY=1). Reads digest-queue/*.json (left there by individual agents' suppressed emails) and walks recent runs.
_disabled_note: Disabled 2026-08-17. This agent's only function is sending the rolled-up digest, and this host has no mail transport (no msmtp, no Graph/SMTP credentials) — the operator chose archive-and-disable. It rolls up successfully then fails on delivery, so it sat red on every tick and that noise is what hid a REAL bug (an unset ${RA_REPO_ROOT} making it exit 2) for weeks. Disable here in the MANIFEST, not with `systemctl --user disable` — the framework re-applies timers from the registry, and a manual disable was reverted within 23 seconds. Re-enable by setting enabled=true, re-registering, and unsetting DIGEST_DISABLED.
